# chore(dev): Docker Compose for manual testing: clean Strapi with the plugin, PostgreSQL and the frontend image

<!-- bogd3v/micelio-plugin-core#42 as read with gh issue view on 2026-10-24: the input of micelio-plugin-core-42.md -->

Part of #62.

## Why

Every builder issue ends with a manual check by the maintainer on Docker, and the plugin has no such setup: `test/strapi/app` is a harness for the suites, not a site a person can open. The reference distribution (`micelio-cms`) installs the plugin only at the 0.7 cut-over, so until then the plugin needs its own way to run next to the frontend.

## What to build

- `compose.dev.yml` at the repository root: `db` (PostgreSQL, the version `micelio-cms` pins), `cms` (a clean Strapi 5 project under `docker/cms/` with the plugin linked from the working tree, `SERVE_ADMIN_PANEL=true`, hot reload of `server/` and `admin/`), `frontend` (the published `micelio` image, `NUXT_PUBLIC_STRAPI_URL` pointing at `cms`, the preview origin allowed).
- `npm run dev:docker` brings it up, seeds one site (`default`, hosts `localhost`) with the fixtures of `test/fixtures/`, and prints the admin URL, the first admin's credentials prompt and the frontend URL.
- `docs/operate/manual-testing.md` (how-to): bring up, reset, point at a local frontend build instead of the image, read logs.
- The CI job `compose` builds the stack and checks `GET /_health` of both services.

## Requirements

- No secret in the repository: keys generated on first run into `.env.docker` (gitignored), `.env.example` documents them.
- Neutral data only (`example.com`, `*.test`); nothing of any site.
- Node and PostgreSQL versions come from `.nvmrc` and from `micelio-cms`; the frontend image tag is the release line in `package.json` (`micelio`).
- `chore` → PATCH.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm run dev:docker` on a clean checkout ends with the admin at `http://localhost:1337/admin` and the frontend at `http://localhost:3000` serving the seeded site.
- [ ] Editing a file under `server/` or `admin/` is reflected without rebuilding the image.
- [ ] `docker compose -f compose.dev.yml down -v` leaves nothing behind; a second `up` seeds again.
- [ ] The `compose` CI job passes.
- [ ] Verified by the maintainer on a clean machine following `docs/operate/manual-testing.md`.

## Progress

Not started.

## Delivery

The agent never pushes on its own. When the maintainer says the manual test on Docker is done, the agent gives the `git add` and `git commit -s` commands with the message (conventional prefix, English, `Co-Authored-By:` trailer); once the maintainer confirms the commit, the agent pushes the branch and opens the PR (REST), with the Docker steps under Tests and `Refs`/`Closes` to this issue. The maintainer reviews the whole diff before merging (standard, sections 11 and 13).
